findings: Original SNL56 lists one steel3/16 by2-1/2in pin per inside/outside bearing-cap assembly. Two cap assemblies of each type imply four pins.
HB20 Plate11 shows a hinged lid at the rear edge of the wool-filled oil cup. Its knuckle widths, diameters and exact profile are undimensioned.
Hinge knuckles are reconstructed as integral features of existing cast caps and lids; new hardware identities are limited to the four printed pins.
The lid remains closed in the standard view. A diagnostic view may omit the lid to inspect the receiving lugs; no pose variant is implemented.
